title: Co-founded SOHO China with Pan Shiyi in 1995
statement: Co-founded SOHO China with Pan Shiyi in 1995, building it into a major Beijing-focused office developer over nearly three decades.

title: Resigned as SOHO China CEO effective September 7
statement: Resigned as SOHO China CEO effective September 7, 2022, and subsequently shifted personal business activity toward the United States through Closer Media and Closer Properties.
outcome: Zhang stepped back from SOHO China's day-to-day leadership in September 2022 and, as of a January 2026 Bloomberg interview, was active discussing US investments as a diversification strategy away from China.
